name: Chalice
author: Erin Carter
description: One singing bowl seen straight down, a modest vessel resting in a generous field of near-black floor over a soft elliptical ground shadow. The thick bronze rim flexes in a cos(4*theta) standing wave rendered as envelope: four warm antinode arcs are the dominant light while eight nodal points stay dark and pinned. The captive pool carries a quiet concentric murmur, hue running from centre out to the rim. A hash-scheduled strike — sometimes a slow mallet swell — floods rim and pool and rings down exponentially, the rim mode melting mid-decay from four arcs toward six as the pool ripples re-space beneath it.

params.label: Bowl size
params.effect: CSS-pixel radius of the bowl, from a small intimate vessel to a larger presence that still leaves a generous dark margin.

params.label: Strike gap
params.effect: Mean seconds between excitations, mixing hashed strikes and occasional slow rim-rub swells.

params.label: Ring time
params.effect: Sustain of rim and pool after excitation; long values give the bowl its meditative hum.

params.label: Ripple detail
params.effect: Continuously scales the pool's ripple wavenumber, from a few broad standing rings to a fine concentric shimmer.
